explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/785: for infinite A, B ⊆ ℕ with A + B containing all large integers and A(x)B(x) ~ x, is A(x)B(x) − x → ∞? Answered yes by Sárközy–Szemerédi. The statement requires infinite A, B of positive integers (0 ∉ A, B, matching A(x) = |A ∩ [1,x]|), IsAdditiveComplement (eventually n ∈ A + B), and A(x)B(x)/x → 1, and concludes A(x)B(x) − x → ∞. Faithful.
